title: Keras Project Solutions - Creating and Training a Model

cues.en: (soft chiming music) Instructor: Welcome back everyone.
cues.zh: （柔和鐘聲音樂）講師：各位，歡迎回來。

cues.en: In this lecture we're going to go over creating and training the model for our project.
cues.zh: 這堂課要為專案建立並訓練模型。

cues.en: Let's head to the notebook and get started.
cues.zh: 到筆記本開始吧。

cues.en: Okay, here I am under creating the model section of our exercise notebook.
cues.zh: 我現在在練習筆記本的建立模型部分。

cues.en: We'll go ahead and run this cell to run the imports necessary, specifically Sequential and Dense and optionally, you can add in dropout layers that we went over during the classification lecture
cues.zh: 執行這個儲存格，匯入必要的 Sequential 和 Dense；也可以加入本節分類課程介紹過的 Dropout 層，

cues.en: of this section of the course.
cues.zh: 就是之前談過的內容。

cues.en: So you have a lot of flexibility here over the number of layers and neurons you want.
cues.zh: 層數和神經元數量有很大彈性。

cues.en: We're going to follow a pretty simple approach here where if we take a look at X_train.shape, it starts off with 78 features.
cues.zh: 我們採取簡單的方法，查看 X_train.shape，一開始有 78 個特徵。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is have my first layer match that.
cues.zh: 所以讓第一層配合這個數量。

cues.en: We will say model.add dense and it's a pretty good rule of thumb that your very first layer should probably match the same number of features for just a normal artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 使用 model.add 加入 Dense；對一般人工神經網路，第一層神經元數大致等於特徵數，是個不錯的經驗法則。

cues.en: And then the activation function, we will choose as rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 激活函數選擇整流線性單元。

cues.en: And then to try to help prevent overfitting, we will go ahead and add in a dropout layer and this is something you can play around with as far as the dropout rate, but I'll go ahead and just do 20% here.
cues.zh: 為了協助防止過度擬合，加入 Dropout 層；可以自行調整丟棄率，我這裡用 20%。

cues.en: And then I'm going to copy this and add in a couple more hidden layers.
cues.zh: 接著複製，再加入幾個隱藏層。

cues.en: But what I'm going to do is I'm essentially going to reduce the number of neurons about in half for each layer.
cues.zh: 我會讓每一層的神經元數大約減半。

cues.en: So we'll go from 78 to 39 and then from 39 to 19 and we'll have dropouts on each of those layers.
cues.zh: 從 78 到 39，再從 39 到 19，每層都加入 Dropout。

cues.en: And then this is the layers that you do need to match up for is the output layer.
cues.zh: 真正需要配合任務的，是輸出層。

cues.en: Recall, we're really just performing binary classification, which means we should have one neuron at the very end.
cues.zh: 還記得，這是二元分類，所以最後應該只有一個神經元。

cues.en: So one dense neuron, so units is equal to one and it should be using an sigmoid activation function.
cues.zh: 一個 Dense 神經元，也就是 units=1，並使用 sigmoid 激活函數。

cues.en: So recall the sigmoid activation function pushes values to be between zero and one.
cues.zh: sigmoid 會把值壓到零和一之間。

cues.en: And next what we're going to do is we will compile the model and this is also where you need to match up.
cues.zh: 接著編譯模型，這裡的設定也要配合任務。

cues.en: So because we're performing a binary classification, the loss should be binary_crossentropy.
cues.zh: 因為執行二元分類，loss 應該是 binary_crossentropy。

cues.en: And then after that we'll go ahead and choose our optimizer and I'll choose Adam for my optimizer.
cues.zh: 然後選擇最佳化器，我用 Adam。

cues.en: Go ahead and run that cell and make sure it compiles.
cues.zh: 執行這個儲存格，確認可以編譯。

cues.en: And then what's next is we need to fit the model.
cues.zh: 下一步就是擬合模型。

cues.en: Here, you have a lot of options and if you wanted to, you could also add in things like early stopping, but I will go ahead and just fit the model for 25 epochs.
cues.zh: 有很多選項，如果想要，也能加入提前停止，不過我先只訓練 25 個 epoch。

cues.en: So we first pass in our training data, so we'll say X_train and y_train,
cues.zh: 首先傳入訓練資料，也就是 X_train 和 y_train，

cues.en: and we'll say epochs is equal to 25.
cues.zh: 設定 epochs=25。

cues.en: Now, because this is a much larger dataset, it's probably a good idea to feed this in in batches.
cues.zh: 因為資料集大很多，最好分批輸入。

cues.en: So as recommended by the task, we'll say batch size is equal to 256.
cues.zh: 依任務建議，把 batch_size 設成 256。

cues.en: And then finally, we also want to pass in our validation data so we can plot out the losses and see if we're overfitting anywhere.
cues.zh: 最後也傳入驗證資料，這樣能畫出損失，檢查是否有過度擬合。

cues.en: So we'll pass in X_test and y_test during the actual fit call.
cues.zh: 所以在 fit 呼叫時傳入 X_test 和 y_test。

cues.en: So if we go ahead and run this, let me clear the old running and let me run this guy, make sure we don't get any errors and there we go.
cues.zh: 執行；先清除舊的執行結果，再跑這個，確認沒有錯誤，好了。

cues.en: So I'm going to essentially end it here and in the very next lecture what we're going to do is after this is done training, we're going to move on to evaluating model performance.
cues.zh: 這裡先結束，下一堂課會在訓練完成後，開始評估模型表現。

cues.en: And again, if you're on a slower computer or you're running this on Google Cloud, you can always choose less epochs, choose a larger batch size or just eliminate batch size.
cues.zh: 再提醒，如果電腦較慢，或在 Google Cloud 執行，可以減少 epoch、增加 batch_size，或直接不指定 batch_size。

cues.en: However, this is enough samples where you should really be feeding it into batches.
cues.zh: 不過這裡樣本夠多，確實應該分批輸入。

cues.en: And the other thing you can do is if this is taking too long to train is as mentioned before, you can actually, before normalizing and before doing train test split, just use df.sample
cues.zh: 如果訓練太久，另一個方法是如前所說，在正規化和切分訓練測試集之前，用 df.sample，

cues.en: to take a sample fraction of the entire dataset, since we are dealing with quite a large dataset.
cues.zh: 抽取整份資料的一部分，因為資料集相當大。

cues.en: Okay, so this is currently training.
cues.zh: 好，目前正在訓練。

cues.en: I will see you in the next lecture where we begin evaluating this model's performance.
cues.zh: 下一堂課見，我們會開始評估模型表現。
